workItems.acceptanceCriteria: AC-1 through AC-5 in the outcome scope: normal CLI/native closeout and new-session reuse launches zero tests; genuine selective input changes give precise reasons from compact executed facts; compatible older records remain usable; exact corrected build integrates without replaying accepted CISLIB work.
workItems.validation: Focused existing native Windows/Linux tests; actual CLI continuation with unchanged report and accounting; one independent review; exact committed build; explicit unit-only read-only CISLIB dispositions and optional single fresh historical profile within shared grant.
